creator: Nathan Tabor
name: D.U.M.M.I.E.™
subtitle: The Real Genius in the Group
status: original creative philosophy and teaching concept

values.canon: DELIGHTFUL - til ya ain’t - their choice
values.interpretation: Lead with delight; others retain their own responses.
Difference and individuality need no apology.

values.canon: MENTAL - like an alcoholic - own your insanity and craziness
values.interpretation: Own your thinking, eccentricity and choices; this is self-description, not a medical classification.

values.canon: WEIRD - M upside down is W - turn it on its side way one way and it’s greater than squared turn it the other way and it’s less than squared
values.interpretation: Rotate the M and look again: an artistic visual metaphor for reexamining assumptions, not a mathematical identity.

values.canon: INTELLECT - in the song gambler. It never discusses when to play. GET OFF THE SIDELINES
values.interpretation: Intellect includes knowing when to participate and choosing to act.

values.canon: ENTERTAINING - if you must, KILL THEM WITH KINDNESS
values.interpretation: Make kindness and joyful expression the constructive response. 'Kill them with kindness' is figurative.

notes: The acronym's second M intentionally resolves to WEIRD; preserve the creator's original letter-to-rotation relationship.
The side-rotated glyph is visual wordplay and not the mathematical symbols > or < by definition.
The reference to an existing song is commentary only; no existing song lyrics or music are reproduced.
